purpose: Baseline identity inventory and bounded source-backed relationship review; preserve all profiles while separating programme membership from qualifying count.
review_scope: All 29 identity rows inventoried. Eight primary manufacturer pages read for selected family/derivative relationships. Not an individual technical, model-year, photograph, licence, market-history or all-jurisdiction road-approval audit.

sources.title: Aventador LP 780-4 Ultimae
sources.read_scope: Overview and monocoque sections: manufacturer calls Ultimae a final version of the Aventador family. Not a new clean-sheet programme.

sources.title: Aventador S
sources.read_scope: Overview, steering and monocoque sections: S has rear-wheel steering and carbon-fibre monocoque; a material derivative within Aventador.

sources.title: Gallardo LP 560-4 Coupé
sources.read_scope: Design and drivability sections identify the named Gallardo coupe and four-wheel-drive concept. Current archive describes a revised nose; it does not verify every earlier model-year specification.

sources.title: Gallardo LP 570-4 Spyder Performante
sources.read_scope: Performance and design sections identify a lightweight V10 soft-top Gallardo derivative.

sources.title: Huracán EVO
sources.read_scope: Overview explicitly describes an evolution; LDVI and steering sections identify dynamics management and rear-wheel steering. These features are not transferred to every Huracán variant.

sources.title: Huracán STO
sources.read_scope: Opening and exterior/braking sections explicitly describe a road-legal motorsport-derived model with revised bodywork, Cofango and CCMR brakes. STO is not the original Super Trofeo race car.

sources.title: Huracán Sterrato
sources.read_scope: Opening, exterior and suspension sections identify raised suspension and Rally calibration. Additional front lamps carry a market-dependent public-road homologation qualification.

sources.title: Motorsport models: Heritage
sources.read_scope: 2009 Gallardo and 2015 Huracán LP 620-2 sections identify separate competition versions. Later Gallardo LP 570-4, Huracán EVO and GT3 entries are distinct named race specifications; their data and production totals are not imported.

programme_groups.admission_case: Carbon-monocoque naturally aspirated V12 supercar programme, with meaningful chassis and final-series derivatives. Strong performance-icon candidate; individual variant counting remains open.
programme_groups.counting_status: pending; no numerical qualifying credit assigned by this review

programme_groups.admission_case: V10 supercar family with coupe and lightweight open-body derivatives plus a separate one-make racing branch. Identity grouping is provisional pending detailed coverage of early Superleggera and Balboni evidence.
programme_groups.counting_status: pending; no numerical qualifying credit assigned by this review

programme_groups.admission_case: V10 supercar programme with evolved dynamics management, a road-going motorsport derivative and a raised-suspension derivative. Engineering differences warrant preserving profiles without automatically multiplying qualifying count.
programme_groups.counting_status: pending; no numerical qualifying credit assigned by this review

limitations: Programme grouping is a curation inference from existing identities and the cited manufacturer relationships; three road groups are not a certified three-car qualifying total.
Separate counting of same-programme bodies and performance derivatives remains pending the owner boundary. No profile is deleted, merged, or automatically declared a duplicate.
Two competition records retain road_legal=0; whether dedicated racing cars qualify remains pending.
All other baseline families and unreviewed fields remain open.
Failed retrospective URLs and homepage redirects were not used as supporting evidence.
